messages:
maria: AM async — quick GPU fleet check-in
maria: What I did: rotated 4 nodes in us-west1-a, pushed prewarm tweak to staging, ran headroom scrape and uploaded CSV to /mnt/ops/headroom/2026-03-18.csv
maria: Blockers: quota bump for GCE us-west1 project still pending (PLAT-9876) — support asked for billing docs. also seeing slightly elevated preemptions in us-west1-b (~2.8% vs baseline 1.1%)
maria: Today: follow up on PLAT-9876, validate vmem config on the new nodes, open CR for canary prewarm bump if quota clears
ken: I uploaded the billing doc to the ticket and emailed support a short justification. link in the ticket comment.
ken: Noticed one node exported a weird oom_kill trace around 09:58, logs excerpt below:
```
Mar 18 09:58:17 host-gpu-12 kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 27345 (python) total-vm:172G
Mar 18 09:58:18 host-gpu-12 containerd[1]: container "model-worker" restarted by liveness probe
```
sam: I can review PR #789 this afternoon — pinged the assignees on GH: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/789
sam: small ask: can we temporarily increase canary prewarm target to 60% for 2hrs after quota bump? should reduce cold-starts for the new model shard. I’ll cap traffic to 5% on the canary route.
jules: ops-bot flagged a transient scaling failure earlier, looks like the autoscaler retried and recovered. putting alert link here for postmortem reference.
ops-bot: [automated] scaling-failed -> recovered for pool gpu-us-west1-a at 10:04:23 UTC. Incident ID inc-20260318-42. Recovered after node drain retry.
maria: ken — can you paste the billing doc link here so I can reference it in PLAT-9876? once support ACKs we submit the quota bump formally.
ken: billing doc link: https://internal.docs/redwood/billing/gce-projects/redwood-prod-2026Q1.pdf :link:
sam: +1 on temporary prewarm bump if quota approved. I’ll draft the rollout plan and canary checks (latency, error-rate, token-cost) and attach to the PR.
maria: if support approves today I’ll schedule a small drain test for us-west1-b after the bump, otherwise proceed with node-level tuning and config rollback plan.
ken: no other infra blockers from my side.
maria: thanks — I’ll update this thread in ~2h with support status. :thumbsup:
thread_text_summary: AM async: rotated nodes, prewarm tweak, waiting on GCE quota bump PLAT-9876; billing doc uploaded; transient autoscaler scaling-failed recovered; PR #789 review and canary prewarm bump planned
